deploybot: Tag created: release-2026-03-19-1.12.5
Repository: infra/redwood-inference
Commit: 9f3c2a7a
Target env: prod
Changelog (summary):
- fix: fallback routing bug causing 5xx on cold starts
- perf: reduce KV cache pressure for gptx-13 under heavy batching
- ops: pin model-variants v2 to ensure parity across regions
Full changelog: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/compare/9f3c2a7a..release-2026-03-19-1.12.5
Notes: manual pinning recommended for Dedicated customers with strict versioning. @jen @miguel

jen: thanks — quick q: is there a canary plan and a rollback step documented? we should coordinate with support for the change window.

miguel: canary plan: 5% for 30m -> 50% for 20m -> 100%. automated health checks (latency/errors). rollback command: `./deploy/tools/rollback-release.sh release-2026-03-19-1.12.5` (requires ops role).

release-qa: QA: ran regression suite id 402 against canary manifest. all core e2e passed, no semantic diffs on the text-generation endpoints.

sam: pinning note: customer-acme uses Dedicated; I'll pin their fleet to `release-2026-03-18-1.12.4` until we clear a 24h burn window. pinging @support to update the change log for them. :thumbsup:

jen: cool. also add a short note to release notes about the model-variant pin so customers see why behavior might differ briefly. i'll update docs/release-notes.md

deploybot: Deployment started: release-2026-03-19-1.12.5 -> prod (canary)
Regions: us-east-1 (canary), us-west-2 (staged)
Status: canary 1/3 pods ready, progress checks running (latency, 5xx rate, mem-usage)
ETA: ~10m

deploybot: Deployment finished: release-2026-03-19-1.12.5 -> prod (all regions)
Duration: 27m
Result: success, no automatic rollback triggered
Notes: keep burn-in monitoring for 24h; ops alert policy will escalate on >0.5% error increase for 15m.

miguel: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the detailed rollout timeline in the release ticket and attach the canary logs.

sam: added customer pinning update to the support ticket. :white_check_mark:
